# Base classes and other elements

The two classes every element derives from, and the elements the catalogue names outside its tables or not at all (shared bases, elements behind a catalogued facade).

## Elements

| Element | What it is for | Callbacks |
|---|---|---|
| [`UltraCanvasLabeledToggleBase`](../Elements/UltraCanvasLabeledToggleBase.md) |  | `onStateChanged`, `onChecked`, `onUnchecked`, `onIndeterminate` (+5 inherited) |
| [`UltraCanvasMediaSurface`](../Elements/UltraCanvasMediaSurface.md) |  | `onNavigate`, `onViewChanged`, `onFilesDropped`, `onDecodeFailed` (+5 inherited) |
| [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](../Elements/UltraCanvasUIElement.md) |  | `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback` |
